unobservedClaims: STATED (https://sheffield.ac.uk/postgraduate/taught/apply/applying, retrieved 2026-09-10): the form is in two parts; Part 1 is personal information, English language ability, previous education and employment, with mandatory fields marked * that must all be completed before Part 2 opens
STATED (same source, 2026-09-10): Part 2 is course selection — up to three courses per application
STATED (same source, 2026-09-10): supporting documents — evidence of previous qualifications, a personal statement — are uploaded into the relevant sections of the form
STATED (same source, 2026-09-10): the application is submitted only when Submit Application is clicked, and incomplete sections are prompted back at that point
STATED (same source, 2026-09-10): no application fee for PGT master's
STATED (https://www.sheffield.ac.uk/postgradapplication, retrieved 2026-09-10): this is the entry point to the Postgraduate Online Application Form
STATED (Vahid, 2026-09-10): all PGT master's start in September; there is no January or February intake
TO OBSERVE: where the login boundary falls — which pages are reachable without an account, and on which host the form lives

ANSWERED (Vahid's direct statement, 2026-09-11): student_chosen — he typed the password he chose at registration; Sheffield did not email one. Not portal_issued, whatever the sibling /arpform/login.app form states

TO OBSERVE, and REPORT BEFORE DECIDING: whether up to three course choices, each submitted separately, is three cases or one case with three targets (ADR-0006; the key is studentId, institutionId, courseId, intake, attemptOrdinal). Do not adapt the model to fit what you expect.
AUTH 1 — Does the applicant choose their own password at account creation? YES (Vahid, 2026-09-11: 'I typed the password I chose')
AUTH 2 — Does the portal generate a credential and email it to them? NO (Vahid, 2026-09-11: 'Sheffield did not email me one')
AUTH 3 — Is there passwordless sign-in — a magic link or emailed code? NONE OFFERED on the entry page (signed-out read, 2026-09-11): e-mail and password, and a reset page

AUTH 4 — Must the email be verified before the form is reachable? NO — observed by Vahid, not by a run (his direct statement, 2026-09-11): 'I entered an email and a password on the New Applicants form, pressed Start Application, and went straight into the form. No email had to be opened, no link clicked.' Sheffield's behaviour, not a property of direct portals

AUTH 5 — Is MFA or a one-time code required, and where? NO — none on the pages read (2026-09-10, 2026-09-11), and observed by Vahid, not by a run (his direct statement, 2026-09-11): 'I signed in again later with email and password only and went straight into the form. No code arrived and none was asked for.' This entry only

AUTH 6 — Is a CAPTCHA present, and where? NONE on the three entry pages or the eleven form pages read; caveat: tag manager was refused, so a tag-injected one could not have loaded; Vahid saw none with tags allowed
AUTH 7 — Does 'Forgot password' work, and does the reset reach the account's own address?
AUTH 8 — Can control be handed back cleanly?
